today.title: Today
today.subtitle: Staff, joinings and leavings, and what comes up this month
today.noMoves: No joining or leaving under way.
today.noEnding: No contract ends within a month.

chart.label: Org chart
chart.empty: No staff member has a position yet. Pick each person's position in their file.

form.mobileHint: They log in with this number and an SMS code.
form.hasFile: This number already has a staff file
form.salaryZero: The salary must be more than zero
form.endBefore: The contract ends before the first day

newStaff.title: New staff member
newStaff.subtitle: Enter their names, mobile and contract; they type their ID card number and the rest in the personal details form. Their panel account and file are made and their joining checklist opens.
newStaff.saved: File created; send them the invite.
newStaff.exists: This staff member was just added. Check the list.
newStaff.account: This number belongs to {{name}}’s account on the site; the names and email came from it.

move.finishLater: From the last day of work on
move.finishConfirm: End their employment? They lose access to the panels.
move.cancelConfirm: Cancel this checklist? Its open tasks are closed.

moves.title: Joining and leaving
moves.subtitle: Each step is a task for whoever does it; tick it to close it
moves.empty: No joining or leaving under way.

person.payHint: Pay from KPIs comes in the next step

salaryDialog.title: Change salary
salaryDialog.effectiveHint: A later day: it takes effect that day

exitDialog.title: Start leaving
exitDialog.text: The leaving checklist opens and each step becomes a task for its owner. After the last day, end the employment to remove their access.

returnDialog.title: Bring back
returnDialog.text: They become active staff again and a joining checklist opens from their first day back. Their old access and groups don't come back: give them again on the access page.

documentDialog.title: Add document
documentDialog.hint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: My tasks and the staff's key days; click a day to add a task

pay.title: Pay & KPIs
pay.subtitle: KPIs, the month's values, rewards and penalties, and the month's pay with insurance and tax

payroll.label: This month's payslips
payroll.noneHint: Starting makes a slip for everyone who worked this month: the base salary from their file, a bonus from the KPI results, insurance and tax from the settings.
payroll.started: This month's pay is worked out.
payroll.draftHint: While it's a draft, every new KPI result or settings change works it out again. Once final, this month's slips and results no longer change.
payroll.finalConfirm: Make this month's pay final? Its slips and KPI results won't change after that.
payroll.openDisputes: Answer the open objections in «Results» first.

slip.title: {{name}}'s payslip
slip.saved: Slip saved and worked out again.

results.label: This month's KPI results
results.noneHint: First set in “KPIs” what is measured for whom; the values then show here.
results.hint: Enter the manual KPIs; the system fills in the automatic ones.
results.notePlaceholder: e.g. was on a work trip that day
results.noteNeeded: Say why the system's value changes
results.refreshed: The automatic values were measured again.

kpis.hint: Each KPI is for everyone, a position, a team or one person. The system measures some of them; a manager enters the rest. Reaching the target is 100%, and the weight is the KPI's share of the person's score.
kpis.noneHint: For example, for everyone: “Late days” with a target of 0; for sales reps: “Contracts won” with a target of 8.
kpis.removeConfirm: Remove this KPI? Its past results are kept.
kpis.name: KPI name
kpis.metricManualHint: A manager enters its value each month in “KPI results”.
kpis.metricAutoHint: The system measures it every night; a manager can change it only with a reason.
kpis.worstHint: The value that scores zero; empty: 0
kpis.worstLowerHint: From this value up it scores zero
kpis.worstSame: The zero point has to differ from the target
kpis.capHint: 120 means going past the target counts up to 120%
kpis.trialHint: Its value shows, but it doesn't count in the score or pay yet.

settings.affectsHint: Off: the KPI score is only shown and pays no bonus (for the first months).
settings.bonus: Bonus at a 100% score (percent of the base)
settings.bonusHint: A lower score pays proportionally less.
settings.insuranceHint: Of total earnings, only for people insured in their file.
settings.taxHint: Tax is worked out on earnings after insurance. Check the default numbers for this year with your accountant.
settings.invalid: Brackets must go up and every field must be a number.
settings.hint: Saving works out draft months again.
settings.penaltyCap: Monthly penalty cap (% of base salary)
settings.penaltyCapHint: No more than this is taken off; empty: no cap.

rules.hint: Each rule turns the KPI score, one KPI's value or a calculator (such as the sales commission) into a reward or a penalty. Together, plus or minus, they add to the month's pay.
rules.noneHint: For example “score of 85% or more: 10% of salary as a bonus” or “each late day after 2: 500,000 tomans off”.
rules.removeConfirm: Remove this rule? Final months don't change.
rules.name: Rule name
rules.calculatorHint: The calculator works the amount out itself. New kinds (such as a writing commission) are added by the tech team.
rules.stepsHint: The first step the value falls in counts. “To” itself is not in the step; empty means no limit.
rules.stepsInvalid: Each step needs an amount, and “to” has to be above “from”.
rules.aboveHint: Units up to this value don't count; empty: 0
rules.pooledHint: The group's value counts together and everyone gets the same (a team reward).
rules.trialHint: Shows on the slip but isn't paid or taken off yet.

review.closeHint: Once closed, this month's automatic values stop changing. Everyone sees their own values on their «Me» page and can object for a few days. While an objection is open, this month's pay can't be made final.
review.closedToast: Month closed; everyone can see their values.
review.reopened: Month opened again; values are measured again.

disputes.title: Objections
disputes.openHint: This month's pay can't be final until every objection is answered.
disputes.newValueHint: If you accept and the value should change, enter it here

detailed.title: Detailed pages
detailed.results: Every value of the month, one by one, with the reason for each change
detailed.kpis: Every KPI in full (for anyone and any team)
detailed.rules: Every reward and penalty rule, such as commission and team rewards

plans.hint: Each group has a plan: a few simple goals, and what reaching them pays. The system measures them every night.
plans.title: {{name}}'s score plan
plans.trialChip: On trial: shown, not paid yet
plans.startHint: You can change every number later.
plans.copyNone: No other group has a plan yet.
plans.goalsTitle: 1. What do we want from this group?
plans.goalsHint: Set each goal with − and +. Importance is each goal's share of the score.
plans.payTitle: 2. What does the score do to pay?
plans.rewardAfter: of base pay as a reward. A lower score, a smaller reward. Zero: no reward.
plans.penaltyHint: For a goal where less is better, such as late days: each unit over the goal is taken from pay.
plans.penaltyNone: Add a goal where less is better first, such as late days.
plans.penaltyBefore: Each unit of “{{name}}” over the goal:
plans.advancedGoals: Each goal now also shows where its score reaches zero and its highest score.
plans.advancedMore: Exceptions for one person, team rewards or commission are on the detailed pages:
plans.others: This group has other rules that don't change here: {{names}}.
plans.trialHint: Scores and rewards are shown to everyone but not paid or taken yet.
plans.needName: Name the goals entered by hand.
plans.previewTitle: Had this plan been in place last month
plans.previewHint: With this group's real values of {{month}}
plans.previewEmpty: Add a goal to see what it does.
plans.previewNobody: Nobody is in this group now.
plans.target: Zero point: from this value the goal scores nothing. Highest score: 120% means going past the goal still counts.
plans.manual: A manager enters it every month
plans.addGoal: Add a goal from the list
plans.manualGoalHint: Such as quality, one number a month

month.noneHint: Make plans for the groups first; each month's scores come here.

step.reviewHint: Look over the values and close the month

month.missingHint: Enter them before closing the month.
month.closeReady: Once closed, everyone sees their score and has a few days to object. Then make the month's pay final.
month.closeObjecting: The month is closed. Staff can object until {{date}}.
month.closeDone: The month is closed. Now make the month's pay final.

me.title: My score and pay
me.subtitle: Your KPIs each month, their values and why, rewards and penalties, and your payslip.
me.none: No KPIs for you this month
me.noneHint: When HR sets KPIs for you, they show here.
me.linesPreview: Worked out with today's values; changes until the month ends. Trial lines aren't paid yet.
me.objectPlaceholder: e.g. I was on a work trip that day
me.lockHint: Your score, rewards and penalties and payslip open only with your account password, every time you open this page.
me.noMoney: No reward or penalty this month.
me.ifReward: If it stays like this, you get about {{amount}} as a reward.
me.ifPenalty: If it stays like this, about {{amount}} is taken.
me.trialMoney: The plan is still on trial; for real it would be about {{amount}}.
me.tipHigher: For a higher score: bring “{{name}}” from {{value}} to {{target}} {{unit}}.
me.tipLower: For a higher score: bring “{{name}}” from {{value}} down to {{target}} {{unit}} or less.

onboarding.title: Personal details form
onboarding.subtitle: These details go into your staff file. Keep your national card and birth certificate at hand. The draft saves itself; come back any time from the account menu (the circle at the top) › “Personal details form”.

sectionHint.identity: Write names and the birth date as on your national card.
sectionHint.education: If you are a student, choose your current level.
sectionHint.bank: Your salary is paid into this account.
sectionHint.emergency: Who should we call if something happens?
sectionHint.documents: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB each.

hint.preferred_name: Optional: what would you like us to call you?
hint.first_name_en: As on your passport or bank card
hint.id_number: Up to 10 digits; on newer cards it is the national code
hint.iban: 24 digits; with or without IR in front
hint.email: Preferably the Gmail you use for work
hint.field_of_study: Type it, or pick a suggested major

fixed.title: Entered by HR
fixed.hint: You log in with this number. If it is wrong, let HR know.

file.birth_certificateHint: Every page; one file per page
file.tooBig: The file is larger than 10 MB
file.limit: You can send up to 10 files. Remove one to add another.

problem.age: The age must be from 15 to 100 years

onboarding.fix: Some answers are missing or not valid; each one says why.
onboarding.returnedNote: HR sent the form back for changes: {{note}}
onboarding.submittedText: You've sent the form. HR will review it and let you know if anything else is needed.
onboarding.approvedText: HR approved the form and your details are in your staff file.
onboarding.none: You have no form to fill in.

review.title: Personal details form
review.sendHint: After logging in with an SMS code the form opens for them; later they find it under the account menu (the circle at the top) › “Personal details form”.
review.none: No form has been sent to this staff member yet.
review.waiting: They haven't sent the form yet.
review.approveConfirm: The answers replace what the file has now. Approve?
review.returnText: They see your note above the form and send it again once fixed.
review.cancelConfirm: Cancel the form? They won't see it anymore.
review.changed: This form was already reviewed or cancelled. Showing it as it is now.

invite.title: Invite to the form
invite.hint: Send this message on WhatsApp or by text. They log in with this number and an SMS code (no password) and the form opens; later it is under the account menu (the circle at the top) › “Personal details form”.
invite.message:
Hi {{name}},
Welcome to Scorize. Please fill in your personal details form here:
{{url}}
To log in, enter {{phone}} and the code we text you.
If you close the page, come back from the account menu (the circle at the top) › “Personal details form”.
invite.messageNoName:
Hi,
Welcome to Scorize. Please fill in your personal details form here:
{{url}}
To log in, enter {{phone}} and the code we text you.
If you close the page, come back from the account menu (the circle at the top) › “Personal details form”.
invite.failed: Couldn't copy; select the text and copy it.
invite.shareFailed: Couldn’t share; copy the message instead.

onboarding.changed: The form changed meanwhile. The page is up to date now.
